segments.name: Beyond Air
segments.description: Develops and markets nitric oxide generator and delivery systems for neonatal pulmonary hypertension and severe lung infections.
segments.evidence: The Company's first device, LungFit ® PH received premarket approval ("PMA") from the FDA in June 2022.

segments.name: Beyond Cancer
segments.description: Majority-owned affiliate developing ultra-high concentration nitric oxide delivered directly to solid tumors.
segments.evidence: Through our majority-owned affiliate Beyond Cancer, Ltd. ("Beyond Cancer"), NO is used to target solid tumors.

segments.name: NeuroNos
segments.description: Majority-owned affiliate developing neuronal nitric oxide synthase inhibitors for autism spectrum disorder and other neurological conditions.
segments.evidence: On March 24, 2025, Beyond Air reorganized its neurology business into a new private company called NeuroNOS Limited ("NeuroNos").

revenueModel.text: Hospitals and distributors pay the company for its LungFit® PH medical device and related components used to deliver nitric oxide to patients.
revenueModel.evidence: Inventories consist primarily of purchased filters, bagging kits, cables, adapters, and other components and accessories required to use the LungFit® PH device held for sale to customers.
